findings.title: Which Voices Move Markets? Speaker Identity and the Cross-Section of Post-Earnings Returns
findings.summary: Speaker-weighted FinBERT on 16,428 earnings call transcripts (2015-2025). Analyst 49%, CFO 30%, Exec 16%, Other 5% weights. OOS Spearman IC 0.142, 2.03% monthly alpha (t=6.49), significant after SUE control. Implementable with cached ProsusAI/finbert + regex speaker parsing of EDGAR transcripts.

findings.title: Taming the Black Swan: AEGIS momentum-gated hierarchical optimization
findings.summary: Volatility-adjusted momentum + minimax-correlation filter + SLSQP Sortino optimization. 20yr walk-forward NASDAQ-100 comparable returns with lower downside vol. Pure scipy/pandas.

findings.title: Continuous Timing Signals for Growth-Defensive Style Allocation
findings.summary: Replaces discrete regime switches with differentiable tanh/softplus scoring (rate relief + SPY drawdown + VIX stress + crowding penalty). OOS Sharpe 1.01, CAGR 19.24%. Directly addresses H318 failure with continuous approach.

findings.title: Leakage-Aware Benchmarking: kNN macro-analog achieves LLM-comparable IC
findings.summary: kNN on lag-shifted FRED features achieves median IC +0.154 comparable to full LLM retrieval pipeline. Published 2026-06-21. Pure sklearn + FRED API. Non-LLM solution to H318 failure.

findings.title: Continuous HMM with Heavy-Tail Emissions for Equity Regime Detection
findings.summary: Student-t/NIG emission distributions fix Gaussian HMM slow autocorrelation decay and degeneracy. Addresses H251 failure (model predicted low_vol 100% of OOS). hmmlearn-compatible.

findings.title: The Mathematics of Heuristic Portfolio Optimization (HPO)
findings.summary: Unifies EW/inv-vol/risk-parity/HRP/RA-HRP as information-restricted Markowitz projections. Relevant to production blend allocation theory.

findings.title: ml4t/diagnostic: Signal diagnostics and backtest evaluation library
findings.summary: 2026 Python library for IC decay, turnover analysis, factor exposure decomposition. Missing validation toolkit.

findings.title: Retail Investor Horizon and Earnings Announcements
findings.summary: Long-horizon retail = underreaction + PEAD; short-horizon = overreaction + reversal. Confirms H174 mechanism.

findings.title: Trends, Volatility, Correlations in Financial Markets
findings.summary: Correlations increase during strong downtrends — crash precursor relevant to H325 AEGIS design.

findings.title: qf-lib: Modular event-driven Python backtesting framework (943★)
findings.summary: Modular multi-broker event-driven backtester, maintained 2026. Architecture upgrade candidate from run_hNNN.py.
